method.name: Schedule-adjusted seven-day equivalent
method.description: Each fantasy score is multiplied by the season's median NHL game count among exact seven-day NiceHL scoring periods, then divided by the actual number of NHL regular-season games played during that scoring period.
method.baseline: Median NHL game count from exact seven-day NiceHL scoring periods in the same NHL season.

sources.name: Shane McDonald NHL as-played schedule CSVs

playoffSupport.description: Each season includes daily NHL regular-season game counts so fantasy playoff scoring periods can be identified and converted to a schedule-adjusted seven-day equivalent.
